outcome: <OK when you reviewed the tests, ERROR when a required input file was missing or unreadable>
missingFiles: <only when outcome is ERROR: the exact paths you could not read. Empty otherwise.>
message: <only when outcome is ERROR: why the review did not happen. Empty otherwise.>

issues.testFile: <repo-relative path of the test file holding this test>
issues.testName: <the test's name, exactly as the file spells it>
issues.evidence: <repo-relative path and the line numbers you read, as tests/thing.test.ts:12-40>
issues.problem: <what the test asserts, and why the brief or plan does not call for it>
issues.fix: <the concrete change to make to that test, written as an instruction>
